events.title: Boulder Creek Farmers Market
events.description: Shop local farms, artisan goods and street-food vendors with live music. Dogs are not allowed in the park during market hours under county health rules. Check the organizer's weekly updates for the current vendor and food-truck lineup.

events.title: Scotts Valley Farmers' Market

events.title: UCSC Farm Strawberry & Flower U-pick
events.description: Pick organic strawberries and/or flowers while supplies last. Strawberry pints are $4; flowers start at $25. Credit card only, free weekend parking, and no dogs except service animals.
events.recurrence: Saturdays, 9:00 AM to noon, July 11 to August 22; while supplies last

events.title: Live Earth Farm U-pick, Strawberries Open
events.description: The farm currently lists strawberries as OPEN at $3/lb. Other crops open as they ripen. No reservation is needed; field abundance can change, so check the official crop-status page before leaving. No dogs.
events.recurrence: Saturdays and Sundays, 10:00 AM to 3:00 PM, through late October; field abundance permitting

events.title: Beautiful Local and Non-local California Native Plants for Your Garden: With Thoughts About the Role of Gardens and Assisted Migration
events.venue: Cabrillo College Horticultural Center, 00 Sanders Ave,, Aptos,, 95003, United States
events.description: A talk by Bart O'Brien, Director of the Tilden Regional Parks Botanic Garden. Beautiful Local and Non-local California Native Plants for Your Garden with Thoughts about the Role of Gardens and Assisted Migration. Don't miss this sure-to-be fun presentation by this leader in the field, recognized for his extensive knowledge, commitment, and enthusiasm for native plants! He is the co-author of California Native Plants for the Garden and has written widely on the subject. "Bart's contributions have been recognized with numerous awards, including the President's Award from CNPS, in 2006 and 2010. He was named Man of the Year by California Garden Clubs, Inc. in 2007. He earned the Horticulturist of the Year Award from the Southern California Horticultural Society in 2005. The 7:00 pm talk will be proceeded by a plant identification workshop at 5:30. There will be door prizes.

events.recurrence: Second Tuesday of each month, 10:00 to 11:00 AM

events.title: Santa Cruz Garden Exchange
events.description: Bring extra seedlings, cuttings, produce, seeds or garden supplies to share. No contribution is required.

events.description: Join the UC Master Gardeners of Monterey, San Benito & Santa Cruz Counties for this hands-on workshop exploring practical, science-based ways to improve your soil and grow healthier plants.

events.title: First Saturday Tour at the Arboretum
events.description: A docent-led introduction to the Arboretum's plant collections and wildlife. Each tour varies with the season and guide. Admission is $13; current members are free. Limited to 15 people; unsuitable weather cancels.
events.recurrence: First Saturday of each month at 11:00 AM

events.title: Free Guided Tour of the UCSC Farm
events.description: Take a free, guided tour of the 30-acre organic UCSC Farm. Visitors can enjoy touring the organically managed greenhouses, hand-worked garden beds, orchards, row crop fields, and children's garden, while learning about the history of the site and the basic concepts of organic farming and gardening.

events.title: Earth Friendly Gardening (Class 4 of 4): Protecting Wildlife and the Environment
events.description: Your garden can make a difference! Discover simple, practical ways to create a healthier, more sustainable landscape by providing food, water, and shelter for pollinators, birds, and other beneficial creatures.

events.title: Open Farm Tours: South County Farms
events.description: Self-guided visits to Blossom's Biodynamic Farm, Esperanza Community Farms, Dos Aguilas Olive Grove, Live Earth Farm, Thomas Farm, Live Oak School Farm and Birdsong Orchard Farm. The $25 Friends & Family Pass covers up to five people per car for both tour days.

events.title: Open Farm Tours: North County Farms
events.description: Self-guided visits to Beeline Blooms, Post Street Farm, Flip Flop Farm, Rodoni Farms, Pie Ranch, Homeless Garden Project, Santa Cruz Permaculture and Swanton Berry Farm. The $25 Friends & Family Pass covers up to five people per car for both tour days.

events.title: Harvest Festival
events.description: Connect with community on the campus farm at the annual Harvest Festival! Harvest Fest will have activities for all ages including face painting, flower pressing, pumpkin painting, cider pressing, tractor rides, live music, and more!

events.title: Santa Cruz Area School Food and Garden Tour
events.venue: School food programs and gardens across Santa Cruz County
events.description: A professional tour for garden educators, nutrition educators and school food-service staff, featuring resilient school gardens and scratch-cooking meal programs. Cost: $200; financial assistance and educator discounts are available.
